Name: Fishing Adjust
Author: ShuaiZhang
Description:
This mod would help to modify the difficulty of fishing. It simply multiply a ratio to the origin fishing data. The difficulty is 80% of origin one by default, you can change it in config.json in the mod folder.

[b]For StardewValley v1.11 and [url=https://github.com/cjsu/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI v[/url]1.6+

If you have issues, double-check that you have the lastest version of SMAPI.

Source: https://github.com/hcoona/StardewValleyMods
Bug Report: https://github.com/hcoona/StardewValleyMods/issues
[/b]

Manifest.Description: This mod helps to adjust fishing difficulty, override the appearance probability of king fishes.
